keyLimits.en: Service fee starts at 0 EUR, but mandatory legal/registry fees are added on top and vary by legal structure

addOns.en: Business address domiciliation (Paris), with CFE tax reduction claims up to 1,000 EUR/year
Business modification filings (director change, registered seat transfer), dissolution filings, professional insurance

cautions.en: The advertised 0 EUR company-creation price covers only LegalPlace's service fee; official registry/legal fees are mandatory and billed separately.
Accounting and most administrative services are priced on request, not shown publicly.

capabilities.en: Online company formation for multiple French legal structures (SAS, SARL, SASU, EURL, SCI, auto-entreprise, associations) with automated document generation and e-signature.
Dedicated accountant support with compliance handling for VAT, financial statements and tax declarations, including the 2026 e-invoicing reform.
Business address domiciliation service in Paris with a professional bank account and capital-deposit attestation.
Handles ongoing legal changes: director changes, registered seat transfers, status amendments, and company dissolution filings.

limitations.en: Focused on French company law only; not usable for formation or compliance outside France.
Most services beyond invoicing software are quote-based or fee-on-top, not fixed self-service pricing.

reason.en: Direct French competitor for online company formation and legal document services.
Same category of French legaltech for business creation and legal procedures.
Comparable guided legal-document and business-formation platform, US/UK-focused rather than French.

unknowns: Full pricing grid for company-formation service fees by legal structure was not shown on the homepage.
Accounting service pricing was not disclosed publicly.
